name: AeonFree Free PHP Web Hosting
free_limit: Free-forever managed PHP/MySQL website hosting with 5 GB storage, advertised unlimited bandwidth, free subdomain or custom domain, free SSL, FTP and up to 400 MySQL databases; no required payment card or forced website ads.
watch_out: Shared-hosting fair-use and account resource limits still apply; unlimited bandwidth is not guaranteed dedicated capacity. Official pages disagree on supported PHP/MySQL versions and disk quotas, so confirm actual account limits and security-supported runtimes before deployment. No root/VPS access included.
